title: Colder beside the Hedge
story: Each dawn, Sofia read the thermometer in the school garden and entered the number in a shared sheet. For three mornings the reading was lower beside the hedge than in the open bed. She realised the hedge was blocking early sun, so those plants stayed colder. The group moved the tender seedlings to the brighter spot and kept recording for another week.

vocabulary.definition: The early morning, when the first light appears.
A line of bushes that forms a barrier.

quiz.question: Where was the morning reading lower?
options: Beside the hedge
In the open bed
Only on the shared sheet
At the brighter spot after the move
quiz.explanation: For three mornings the reading was lower beside the hedge than in the open bed.
quiz.supportingSentence: For three mornings the reading was lower beside the hedge than in the open bed.

quiz.question: Why were the plants by the hedge colder?
options: The hedge was keeping the early sun off them
The thermometer was broken every morning
The open bed was in deeper shade
The seedlings had already been moved
quiz.correctAnswer: The hedge was keeping the early sun off them
quiz.explanation: Sofia realised the hedge was blocking the early sun, so those plants stayed colder.
quiz.supportingSentence: She realised the hedge was blocking early sun, so those plants stayed colder.

quiz.question: What does moving the seedlings show about the group?
options: They acted on Sofia’s explanation of the cold spot
They decided to stop recording temperatures
They wanted the young plants to stay cold
They thought the open bed was too bright to use
quiz.correctAnswer: They acted on Sofia’s explanation of the cold spot
quiz.explanation: After she explained the cold hedge, the group moved the seedlings to the brighter spot.
quiz.supportingSentence: The group moved the tender seedlings to the brighter spot and kept recording for another week.

quiz.question: What does tender mean in this story?
options: Easily hurt by cold
Brighter than a hedge
Written on a shared sheet
Measured only at noon
quiz.explanation: The tender seedlings are the young plants they move away from the colder spot.
quiz.supportingSentence: The group moved the tender seedlings to the brighter spot and kept recording for another week.

quiz.question: Why did the group keep recording for another week?
options: They wanted to see the temperatures after the move
They wanted the hedge to block more sun
They wanted to stop using the thermometer
They wanted the dawn numbers kept secret
quiz.correctAnswer: They wanted to see the temperatures after the move
quiz.explanation: They kept recording after moving the seedlings, so they could follow what happened next.
quiz.supportingSentence: The group moved the tender seedlings to the brighter spot and kept recording for another week.
